# Faiq Hammam

> Faiq Hammam, also known as Fa'iq Hammam Mutaqin or cyclocerine, is an IT Engineer and researcher focused on AI/ML, quantitative finance, full-stack web development, Web3, and IoT. He studies Informatics at Universitas Pembangunan Nasional "Veteran" Yogyakarta.

## Technical Skills

- Machine learning and AI: PyTorch, CUDA, deep reinforcement learning (PPO), time-series forecasting, scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy.
- Web development: Next.js, React, Vite, Django, Django REST Framework, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS.
- Programming languages: Python, C++, C, SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust.
- Tools and environments: Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, Armbian), Git, Docker, CUDA Toolkit, VS Code, Jupyter Notebook.

## Publications & Research

- Q-ALU (Quant Asymmetric Leaky Unit): A market-psychology-aware activation function with downside risk protection for high-frequency quantitative trading and deep reinforcement learning. Working paper on SSRN.
  - SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7365098
  - DOI: https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7365098
  - Official PyTorch implementation: https://github.com/cyclocerine/qalu-pytorch
